jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Risk Management
jobs.description:
Questrade is on a mission to help Canadians to become much more financially successful and secure.

For nearly 30 years, Questrade Financial Group has been delivering on that mission through investing, banking, mortgages, and real estate. Together, we tilt finance in favour of ambitious Canadians, creating new ways for them to seize the financial future they deserve.

We're looking for people who are ready to enter their career inflection point. Mission-driven, exceptional folks that never settle. The work here is hard because the responsibility is real. If that's the standard you've been looking for, keep reading.

Req # 4400

The return on your career investment

Compensation and incentives built to reward the value you bring.
RRSP matching of up to 6%.
Health and wellness resources and programs, including $5,000 in mental health practitioner coverage.
$5,000 in tuition subsidies for job-related courses, every year.
100% parental top-up, up to 26 weeks for birthing parents and 18 weeks for non-birthing parents.
A hybrid environment, with at least three days in the office built for working together.
Paid vacation, personal, and sick days.
A community care day to give back to the causes you care about.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

We’re looking for our next Director, Enterprise Risk Management

Reporting to the Chief Risk Officer, the Director, Enterprise Risk Management will be primarily responsible for leading and enhancing the Enterprise Risk Management program at Questbank, in compliance with OSFI regulatory requirements.

The mandate

In This Role, You Will

Design, implement and manage the enterprise risk management programs
Oversee the development and maintenance of Questbank’s policy and framework documentation and repository
Own the enterprise risk appetite framework and ensure processes are in place to monitor and report on performance, including the ability to identify and manage any exceptions
Chair the Enterprise Risk Management Committee, and attend as a key member of other senior management committees
Ensure the design and operating effectiveness of each of the enterprise risk management programs is appropriate given the size and complexity of the business, and ensure they meet and continue to comply with both internal and regulatory expectations
Contribute to product development and new initiative processes across the Company, from an Enterprise Risk Management perspective
Act as the key point of contact for all enterprise risk matters with the Board and Committees, including supporting the Board’s Risk Review Committee
Act as the key point of contact for all enterprise risk matters with OSFI
Manage strong working relationships with business partners, including other control functions
Provide leadership, training, motivation, coaching and evaluation to the enterprise risk team and the broader company on enterprise risk matters

You’re ready for this mandate if you have the following qualifications

University degree in a business related field
10+ years of enterprise risk management experience as part of the second line of defense in an OSFI regulated institution preferred. Combinations of experience in financial and non-financial risk is preferred. Strong business acumen and knowledge of principles, techniques, current trends, best practices, regulations, policies, and programs related to risk management
10+ years of people management experience is preferred
A desire for high performance and ability to make an impact
A solutions-oriented mindset, critical thinking and sound decision making
Strong collaboration, influencing, conflict resolution and stakeholder relationship building and people and process management skills
Proven ability to manage multiple deliverables with firm deadlines
Excellent written communication skills – the ability to articulate key messages concisely and effectively
Experience writing policies
Experience creating reports for senior management
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Suite, Power BI, RPA advantageous
Bring a positive, can-do attitude to our organization, using creative solutions to solve problems.
Strong team player who motivates others to achieve group success.
Establish and build on healthy working relationships with your team and peers.
Use open communication and collaboration to solve problems and manage deliverables.
Work well in a dynamic and fast paced environment with the ability to navigate through organizational change.

Enter your career inflection point. Apply now.

Technology and AI

We mix human ingenuity with advanced technology. For ambitious builders like you, we provide the latest technology to enable your creativity. You'll have everything you need to build the best outcomes and products for our clients.

Diversity and Inclusion

At Questrade Financial Group of Companies, we’re committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible work environment where individuals are treated with dignity and respect. Our global team reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and operate in.

Accessibility statement

Candidates selected for an interview are contacted directly. If you require accommodation during the recruitment or selection process, please let us know. We will work with you to meet your needs.

AI in hiring

Questrade Financial Group of companies Applicant Tracking System uses artificial intelligence (AI) for application screening. The AI system operates on predetermined criteria, with final decisions subject to human review.
